title: rec desktop update feed
description: update.json, attached to every app release beside update.json.sig — the base64 Ed25519 signature of this file's exact bytes, made with the release key whose public half the Mac and Windows apps carry. The apps read it at https://github.com/rokrokss/recly/releases/latest/download/update.json, verify the signature before reading a field, and offer the package when it is newer than they are. Written by scripts/desktop-update.swift. See docs/recly.md §12 "Updates", §14 "Updates" and §15 "Desktop updates".

version.description: The display version every platform shares.

notes.description: The release's page, where a copy that cannot replace itself sends the user.

macos.description: The release's DMG. A Mac offers it when build is above its own CFBundleVersion.

windows.description: The release's MSI. A PC offers it when installerVersion is above its own MSI version, compared field by field.

size.description: Bytes; the download is refused unless it is exactly this long.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex; the download is refused unless it hashes to this.
